auth.session_expired: Igihe cyo gukorana cyararangiye. Ongera winjire.

dashboard.title: Imbonerahamwe yo gushakisha
dashboard.no_exceptions: Nta bitagenda neza — byose ni byiza

application.workspace_description: Suzuma dosiye z’abasaba akazi z’ikigo cyawe kandi ufungure dosiye urebe amateka y’ibyemezo.
application.search_description: Shakisha ukoresheje nimero ya dosiye, kode y’itunganwa, cyangwa imimerere iriho.
application.no_results_description: Gerageza indi nimero ya dosiye, kode y’itunganwa, cyangwa imimerere.
application.no_applications_description: Dosiye zahawe ikigo cyawe zizagaragara hano.
application.no_history: Nta mateka y’imimerere y’iyi dosiye araboneka kugeza ubu.
application.identifier_unavailable: Igikorwa ntigishoboka: umurongo wa edge nta nimero y’ubusabe ufite
application.assignment_and_decision: Aho dosiye iri n’icyemezo cya nyuma
application.partial_description: Umurongo wa edge watanze amakuru y’ubusabe, ariko amateka ntiyari urutonde. Suzuma ibice by’ubusabe kandi wongere ugerageze mbere yo gufata icyemezo.

errors.network: Ntibishoboka guhuza. Reba umuyoboro wawe wa interineti.
errors.forbidden: Nta burenganzira ufite bwo gukora iki gikorwa.
errors.validation: Kosora amakosa akurikira mbere yo gukomeza.

offline.banner: Nta interineti ufite. Impinduka zizahuzwa igihe uzongera guhuza.
offline.sync_unavailable: Amanota yafashwe asigara kuri iki gikoresho. Kuyohereza kuri dosiye y'ishakisha ntibishoboka ubu, bityo ntukuremo amakuru cyangwa uhereze iyi tablet mbere y'uko umukozi yemeza ko amanota yoherejwe.

biometric_consent.title: Kwemera Gufatwa kw'Amakuru ya Biometrike
biometric_consent.body: Mu gukomeza, wemera ko {{agencyName}} ifata kandi igakoresha amakuru yawe ya biometrike (ibikumwe, ifoto y'mu maso) mu gahunda ya USRP yo gushakisha abakozi. Amakuru yawe azabungabungwa nk'uko amategeko arengera amakuru abiteganya.

officer_actions.reject_confirm_body: Urizeye ko ushaka kwanga ubu busabe? Ibi ntibishobora gusubizwa inyuma.
officer_actions.action_completed_description: Dosiye yavuguruwe. Dosiye n’imirongo yayo birimo kuvugururwa.
officer_actions.conflict: Dosiye yahindutse mbere y’uko igikorwa kirangira
officer_actions.conflict_description: Ongera ufungure dosiye urebe imimerere iriho mbere yo kongera kugerageza.
officer_actions.no_change_description: Backend yagaragaje NO_CHANGE. Dosiye yongeye kuvugururwa kugira ngo urebe imimerere iriho.
officer_actions.transition_receipt: Igisubizo cya backend: {{outcome}}. Imimerere yabanje: {{fromStatus}}. Imimerere igaragara: {{status}}.
officer_actions.no_permission: Uruhare rwawe rukwemerera kureba iyi dosiye, ntirukwemerera kuyifataho icyemezo.

scan.no_camera: Kamera ntiboneka kuri iki gikoresho. Injiza kode n'intoki.
scan.camera_error: Ntibishoboka gufungura kamera. Injiza kode n'intoki.
scan.fallback_placeholder: Omeka cyangwa andika agaciro ka kode ya QR

upload.drop_hint: Shyira dosiye hano, cyangwa kanda uzitoranye

apply.title: Ohereza ubusabe
apply.category_help: Hitamo icyiciro. Umurongo wa backend ni wo ugena urwego rubishinzwe hashingiwe kuri iki cyiciro.
apply.agency_derived: Iki cyiciro gishinzwe {{agency}}. Ntugomba guhitamo cyangwa kohereza urwego.

categories.OFFICER_FOUR_YEAR_UR: RCS — ofisiye w’imyaka ine muri UR

apply.education_help: Andika nimero ya {{registry}} isabwa kuri iki cyiciro. Ni yo nimero y’amashuri backend isaba kuri iki cyiciro.
apply.declaration_copy: Ndemeza ko amakuru ntanze ari ukuri kandi yuzuye. Uku kwemeza ni ukw’iyi fomu gusa; ibyo twohereza kuri backend ni icyiciro na nimero y’amashuri byemewe gusa.
apply.review_body: Kohereza bizohereza gusa icyiciro na nimero y’amashuri bisabwa binyuze muri session y’usaba. Backend ni yo igena dosiye n’imimerere yayo.
apply.success_body: Backend yakiriye ubusabe bwawe. Urutonde rw’ubusabe bwawe ruvuguruwe; nta makuru y’ubusabe yahimbwe hashingiwe ku gisubizo cyo kohereza.
apply.replay_body: Backend yongeye gutanga igisubizo cy’ukohereza kwabanje kuri iyi nimero y’umutekano. Urutonde rw’ubusabe bwawe ruvuguruwe.
apply.validation_body: Backend yanze ibice by’ubusabe cyangwa nimero y’umutekano. Genzura fomu wongere ugerageze.
apply.duplicate_body: Backend ivuga ko usanzwe ufite ubusabe kuri aya mahirwe yo gushaka akazi. Urutonde rw’ubusabe ni rwo kuriya.
apply.conflict_body: Backend ntishobora kwakira ubu busabe muri iyi mimerere.

conflicts.NO_OPEN_CAMPAIGN: Nta gikorwa cyo gushaka abakozi gifunguye kuri iki cyiciro.
conflicts.CROSS_AGENCY_ACCEPT_LOCK: Ubu busabe bwabujijwe n’ifunga ryo kwemererwa risanzweho.
conflicts.ILLEGAL_TRANSITION: Backend ntishobora kwakira ubu busabe muri iyi mimerere.

apply.offline_body: Draft yawe igumye kuri iki gikoresho. Kohereza bisaba umurongo wa applicant edge; nta busabe bwoherejwe.
apply.dependency_body: Backend ntiyabashije kugera kuri serivisi isabwa. Draft yawe igumye kuri iki gikoresho; wongere ugerageze nyuma.
apply.session_body: Session yawe yarangiye cyangwa ntiboneka. Ongera winjire mbere yo kohereza.
apply.forbidden_body: Backend yanze iyi session cyangwa uburinzi bwa CSRF. Ongera winjire wongere ugerageze.
apply.rate_limit_body: Tegereza gato mbere yo kongera kohereza ubusabe.
apply.campaign_error_body: Reba umuyoboro wa interineti hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
apply.campaign_none_body: Nta itangazo ryemerera kwiyandikisha muri iki gihe. Ongera usuzume nyuma, cyangwa ukurikize amatangazo yemewe.
apply.documents_help: Ohereza buri nyandiko nka PDF, JPEG cyangwa PNG. Inyandiko ihita yakirwa gusa — izasuzumwa nyuma, kandi nta gisubizo uzabona kuri uru rupapuro.
apply.document_file_label: Dosiye (PDF, JPEG cyangwa PNG, itarenze 10 MB)
apply.upload_error: Inyandiko ntiyabashije koherezwa. Genzura dosiye hanyuma wongere ugerageze.

upload_refusals.NOT_ACCEPTING_DOCUMENTS: Iyi dosiye y’isaba ntiyakira inyandiko muri iki cyiciro.
upload_refusals.UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENT_TYPE: Ubu bwoko bw’inyandiko ntibwemewe kuri iri tangazo.
upload_refusals.UNSUPPORTED_FILE_CONTENT: Iyi dosiye si PDF, JPEG cyangwa PNG ishobora gusomwa.
upload_refusals.UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE: Dosiye za PDF, JPEG na PNG zonyine nizo zemewe.
upload_refusals.DOCUMENT_REJECTED_MALWARE: Iyi dosiye yanzwe kuko ishobora guteza ibibazo. Genzura telefone yawe ukoreshe kopi itarimo ikibazo.
upload_refusals.FILE_TOO_LARGE: Iyi dosiye ni nini cyane (itarenze 10 MB).

exam_qr.title: Kode QR y’ikizamini cyanjye
exam_qr.ready_body: Kurura cyangwa ucapure iyi kode QR, uyizane hamwe n’indangamuntu yawe ku isuzuma ry’umubiri. Abakozi bayisoma ku muryango.
exam_qr.download_failed: Ifoto ntiyabashije gukorwa muri iyi mushakisha. Koresha Capura cyangwa ufate ifoto ya ekrani.
exam_qr.present_at_gate: Erekana iyi kode hamwe n’indangamuntu yawe ku muryango w’isuzuma.
exam_qr.keep_private: Iyi kode ni ubutumire bwawe bwite. Ntuyisangize abandi.
exam_qr.not_found: Iyi dosiye y’isaba ntiyabonetse mu zawe.
exam_qr.load_failed: Kode QR yawe ntiyabashije kuboneka. Reba interineti hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
exam_qr.unavailable_body: Wahawe umwanya w’ikizamini ariko kode ntirategurwa. Ongera urebe nyuma cyangwa uvugane n’urwego.

PENDING.title: Dosiye yawe iri gusuzumwa
PENDING.body: Kode QR yawe izahita igaragara hano igenzura ry’ubushobozi bwawe rirangiye kandi wahawe umwanya w’ikizamini. Ushobora kureka uru rupapuro rufunguye.

ON_HOLD.title: Dosiye yawe iri gusuzumwa n’umukozi
ON_HOLD.body: Umukozi ari gusuzuma dosiye yawe. Kode QR izatangwa isuzuma rirangiye.

COMPLETED.title: Isuzuma ryawe ryarangiye
COMPLETED.body: Icyiciro cy’ikizamini cyarangiye; kode QR ntikenewe.

CLOSED.title: Nta kode QR kuri iyi dosiye
CLOSED.body: Iyi dosiye ntigikora, ntabwo rero hari ubutumire bw’ikizamini.

UNAVAILABLE.title: Kode QR yawe ntiraboneka
UNAVAILABLE.body: Wahawe umwanya w’ikizamini ariko kode ntirategurwa. Ongera urebe nyuma cyangwa uvugane n’urwego.

WALK_IN.title: Kwiyandikisha ku kibuga
WALK_IN.body: Wiyandikishije ku kibuga ku munsi w’ikizamini, ntabwo rero hari ubutumire bwa QR.

ADMITTED.title: Winjiye
ADMITTED.body: Kode QR yawe yakoreshejwe i {{venue}} ku wa {{time}}. Ntishobora kongera gukoreshwa.

gate.title: Irembo ry'aho ikizamini kibera
gate.intro: Sikana kode QR y'ikizamini y'umukandida, genzura indangamuntu ye imbonankubone, hanyuma umwinjize. Buri kode QR yinjiza umuntu umwe, rimwe gusa.
gate.venue_help: Nk'uko byanditse ku butumire bw'abakandida. Bibikwa kuri iki gikoresho.
gate.qr_help: Sikana ukoresheje kamera, cyangwa icyuma gisikana gifatwa mu ntoki muri iki kibanza.
gate.nid_help: Imibare 16 yandukuwe ku ikarita nyirizina. Igenzurwa kuri dosiye, ntibikwa.
gate.no_permission_title: Inshingano zawe ntizikwemerera kwinjiza ku irembo
gate.no_permission_body: Kwinjiza ku irembo bigenewe umukozi ushinzwe igenzura.
gate.failed_body: Nta cyanditswe. Genzura umuyoboro hanyuma wongere ugerageze.

ADMITTED.title: Yinjiye
ADMITTED.body: {{code}} · {{category}} — kwitaba mbere ya {{hour}}. Iyi kode QR yamaze gukoreshwa.

ALREADY_ADMITTED.title: Kode QR yamaze gukoreshwa — ntumwinjize
ALREADY_ADMITTED.body: Iyi kode QR yakoreshejwe i {{venue}} saa {{time}}{{by}}. Ohereza umukandida ku mugenzuzi.

IDENTITY_MISMATCH.title: Indangamuntu ntihuye — ntumwinjize
IDENTITY_MISMATCH.body: Nimero y'indangamuntu iri ku ikarita si iy'umukandida {{code}}. Iki gikorwa cyanditswe.

WRONG_VENUE.title: Si aha hantu
WRONG_VENUE.body: Iyi kode QR ni iy'i {{venue}}. Muyobore ahongaho.

TOO_EARLY.title: Si uyu munsi
TOO_EARLY.body: Iyi kode QR ni iy'ikizamini cyo ku wa {{date}}.

EXPIRED.title: Kode QR yarangije igihe
EXPIRED.body: Umunsi w'ikizamini w'iyi kode QR ({{date}}) warenze.

invalid_reasons.WRONG_AGENCY: Iyi kode QR ni iy'ikizamini cy'urundi rwego.
invalid_reasons.UNKNOWN_TICKET: Nta dosiye y'uru rwego ihuye n'iyi kode QR.
invalid_reasons.TICKET_NOT_ISSUED: Iyi kode QR ntiyatanzwe na sisitemu: ishobora kuba yarahinduwe cyangwa yarahimbwe.
